name: firefly-mcp
description: Operate a Firefly III personal-finance instance through its MCP endpoint. Bundles a skill that teaches Claude the 25-tool surface, four slash commands for common dashboards, an agent for categorization audits, and the MCP server registration.

firefly_url.title: Firefly III base URL
firefly_url.description: Base URL of your Firefly III instance, without a trailing slash. The plugin will call POST {url}/api/v1/mcp. Example: https://firefly.example.com

firefly_token.title: Firefly III Personal Access Token
firefly_token.description: A Personal Access Token created in Firefly III under Options → Profile → OAuth → Personal Access Tokens. The plugin sends it as a Bearer header.
